picks.excerpt: Argonne National Laboratory's ChemGraph is an open-source AI framework that uses LLMs and specialized agents to translate natural-language scientific problems into executable computational-chemistry calculations, automating battery, combustion and materials simulations for non-experts.
picks.rationale: Open-source LLM-agent framework lets non-experts run computational-chemistry and materials simulations from plain language — high actionability, materials sub-domain.

picks.excerpt: Technion's BetaDescribe is an AI system that translates raw protein sequences into natural-language descriptions, generating evidence-based hypotheses about the functions of otherwise-uncharacterized proteins for drug discovery and biotech.
picks.rationale: Novel protein-to-text model surfaces functions of uncharacterized proteins, feeding real drug-discovery hypotheses — distinct biology/protein sub-domain.

picks.excerpt: An international team at GSI/FAIR trained a deep neural network (RHINE) to model r-process heating in neutron-star mergers, letting simulations of how the universe forges its heaviest elements run far faster and more accurately.
picks.rationale: Neural network makes heavy-element nucleosynthesis simulations faster and more accurate — a concrete method advance in astrophysics from a credible GSI/FAIR team.

picks.excerpt: Judith S. Beck weighs AI mental-health chatbots against human therapists: chatbots are low-cost and available 24/7 but carry real risks, while clinicians tailor treatment with empathy and clinical judgment an LLM cannot yet replicate.
picks.rationale: Clinician-authored assessment of where AI mental-health chatbots help and where they fail — mental-health/cognition sub-domain from a domain-expert source.

picks.excerpt: Anthropic's 'Jacobian lens' reveals a hidden 'J-space' inside Claude Opus 4.6 — words that shape a model's upcoming output without appearing in it — offering the clearest glimpse yet into how LLMs represent and weigh concepts internally.
picks.rationale: Concrete interpretability discovery into how LLMs internally represent concepts — top-tier outlet, high novelty, distinct interpretability sub-domain.
